name: Markdown
description: A WYSIWYG Markdown editor for local files, powered by Typedown and Muya.
releaseNotes: Initial release: Typora-style WYSIWYG Markdown editor with local file support (open/save via native dialogs), outline, folder browsing, recent files, task lists, tables, and HTML export.

zh-CN.name: Markdown 编辑器
zh-CN.description: 所见即所得的 Markdown 编辑器，支持本地文件打开/保存、大纲、文件夹浏览、任务列表、表格与 HTML 导出。
